content:
Hi all! ATProto Boston is having their September meetup Thursday 7PM @ Aeronaut Brewing Company in Somerville! Would love to see you all there!

Calling all open source contributors, internet enthusiasts, free speech preservationists, artists, civic technologists, et al! Atproto Boston is coming together for our monthly brewery meetup (every second Thursday).

This time we will meet at Aeronaut Brewing Company in Somerville, an energetic, buzzy brewery/taproom offering craft suds to beer fans, food stalls, along with live music & board games. Come join in!
